dev.template: Start the B2C storefront dev server. The owuan API must also be running at localhost:3000. Use: source ~/.zshrc && cd /Users/owuan/www/b2c-client-storefront && pnpm dev. The storefront runs at localhost:3002.

check.template: Run linting on the storefront codebase. Show any issues found.

browser-test.description: Storefront sayfalarını browser ile test et
browser-test.template: Ensure both the owuan API (localhost:3000) and storefront (localhost:3002) dev servers are running. Use next-devtools_browser_eval to test storefront pages. Start browser, navigate to http://localhost:3002, and test the homepage, product page, search page, cart, and checkout flow. Take screenshots and check console for errors. The API key is already configured in .env — auth should work automatically.
